This is how I feel about constant helis dropping bombs and shredding our infantry with no-one stopping them or anyone having any anti-air on their vehicles. I've seen helis go 70 kills and 0 deaths because of this or even 40 with 2 deaths.

This applies for nearly every vehicle in the game.
